name: Security check on new controller
description: When a new controller file is created, scans it for common security issues: missing auth guards, missing roles decorator, exposed sensitive fields, unvalidated inputs. Alerts the developer before code is committed.

action.prompt:
A new NestJS controller was just created at ${file}. Read the file and perform a security review checking for ALL of the following issues:

1. MISSING GUARDS: Every route handler must have @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard). Flag any handler missing either guard.
2. MISSING ROLES: Every route handler must have @Roles(...) decorator. Flag any handler missing it.
3. EXPOSED SENSITIVE FIELDS: Check that password_hash, refresh tokens, and internal IDs are not returned in responses.
4. MISSING VALIDATION: Check that every @Body() parameter uses a DTO class with class-validator decorators — no plain objects.
5. MISSING OPENAPI: Check that every handler has @ApiOperation and @ApiResponse decorators.
6. RATE LIMITING: Check that auth-related endpoints have @Throttle() decorator with strict limits.
7. SCOPE LEAKAGE: Check that teacher endpoints filter by teacher_id and student endpoints filter by student_id — no unscoped database queries.

For each issue found, show:
- The method name
- The specific problem
- The exact fix (show the corrected code snippet)

If no issues found, say 'Security check passed ✅'
action.description: Ask Kiro agent to review the new controller for security issues
